nextResearchBoundary: Neither this bounded ablation nor the default-loss 40-update adapter changed the decoded whole-song events. Do not repeat these settings or claim progress from loss alone. A separately frozen optimization-capacity or longer-exposure study needs actual decoded gains, unchanged cutoff policy, cross-song safety and independent listening before any production promotion.
interpretation: The rare-program-loss hypothesis motivated a valid experiment but did not improve its measured note output at this dose. No 70/90 percent accuracy target was reached, no listening sample is represented as improved, and no rejected model replaces the live checkpoint.
